about.title: About Research Factors
about.subtitle: Know More. Choose Better.
intro: The internet gives us more information than ever. But having more information does not always make decisions easier.
Products change. Prices change. Companies make different claims. Reviews can be difficult to compare. Important details are often spread across multiple sources.
Research Factors exists to make that process easier.
We research, compare, and explain information so readers can better understand their options before making a decision.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.description: Research Factors is an independent research and information platform covering products, services, companies, industries, and topics that people are actively researching.
whatWeDo.summary: We bring relevant information together, organize it clearly, and provide the context needed to understand it.
whatWeDo.goal: The goal isn't simply to tell you what to choose. The goal is to help you understand why an option may or may not be right for you.

whyWeExist.title: Why Research Factors Exists
whyWeExist.lead: A search can give you hundreds of results in seconds. But finding a useful answer often takes much longer.
challenges: Figure out which factors actually matter
whyWeExist.mission: Research Factors is built around that problem. We want to reduce the time between having a question and having enough useful information to make an informed decision.

approach.title: How We Approach Research
approach.subtitle: We believe useful research should be understandable. Our approach focuses on four things:

steps.title: Research
steps.description: We gather information from relevant sources and look beyond a single claim or viewpoint where possible.

steps.title: Compare
steps.description: We put relevant options, features, data, and differences into context so they are easier to evaluate.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: Information without context can be difficult to use. We explain what the information means and why it may matter.

steps.title: Decide
steps.description: The final decision belongs to you. Our role is to give you useful information and context so you can make that decision with greater confidence.

notOneSizeFitsAll.title: We Don't Believe in One-Size-Fits-All Answers
notOneSizeFitsAll.lead: There is rarely one option that is right for everyone. The right product, service, company, or solution can depend on:
factors: How you intend to use it
notOneSizeFitsAll.conclusion: That's why our content aims to explain both strengths and limitations rather than simply presenting something as universally better.

contentTypes.title: Our Content
contentTypes.subtitle: Research Factors publishes different types of research depending on what readers need.

types.name: Comparisons
types.description: We examine multiple options using relevant criteria so their differences are easier to understand.

types.name: Reviews
types.description: We look at the important characteristics, advantages, limitations, and use cases of a product, service, or solution.

types.name: Research & Analysis
types.description: We explore companies, industries, markets, trends, and topics using available information and data.

types.name: Guides
types.description: We break down complicated subjects into practical information that readers can understand and use.

types.name: Explainers
types.description: We answer questions and explain concepts without assuming that the reader is already an expert.

transparency.title: Transparency Matters
paragraphs: We want readers to understand how our content is created.
Research Factors may work with companies and organizations through sponsorships, partnerships, advertising, affiliate relationships, or other commercial arrangements.
Where a commercial relationship is relevant to the content, we aim to make it clear.
Commercial relationships do not automatically determine our editorial conclusions.

brandRelationship.title: Our Relationship With Brands
paragraphs: Brands and organizations are an important part of the markets we research.
We may provide opportunities for companies to introduce their products, services, or ideas to relevant readers through appropriate commercial and sponsorship programs.
At the same time, readers should be able to distinguish between information created to inform them and content created as part of a commercial relationship.
We believe both can exist on the same platform when the distinction is clear.

curiousReaders.title: Built for Curious Readers
curiousReaders.lead: Research Factors is for people who don't want to stop at the first search result. It is for readers who ask:
questions: What does the available information actually tell me?
curiousReaders.closing: If you approach decisions with that kind of curiosity, Research Factors is built for you.

continuousImprovement.title: Built to Keep Improving
paragraphs: Research doesn't end when an article is published.
Information changes. Products evolve. Companies update their offerings. Markets move. New data becomes available.
We aim to update our content when meaningful information changes and correct material errors when they are identified.
We also welcome constructive feedback from readers who can help us improve the quality and usefulness of our work.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.statement: Make research easier to understand and decisions easier to navigate.
mission.lead: We don't want to add more noise to an already crowded internet. We want to create information that is:
mission.closing: Because a better decision often starts with a better understanding of the options.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: At Research Factors, we respect your privacy and are committed to handling personal information responsibly.
This Privacy Policy explains what information we may collect, how we use it, when we may share it, how we protect it, and the choices available to you when you use our website.
By using Research Factors, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Information We May Collect
paragraphs: Depending on how you interact with Research Factors, we may collect different types of information.

subSections.title: Information You Provide Directly
subSections.content: You may voluntarily provide information when you submit a review or opinion, contact us, submit a correction or feedback, subscribe to newsletters, or participate in website features. This information may include your name, email address, username, review content, and other information you choose to provide.

subSections.title: Automatically Collected Information
subSections.content: When you visit our website, certain technical information may be collected automatically, including IP address, browser type, device type, operating system, approximate location derived from technical data, referring website, pages visited, date and time of access, and general performance telemetry.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
paragraphs: We use personal information only for legitimate purposes consistent with applicable law, including:
bullets: Operating and maintaining Research Factors.
Providing website functionality and caching performance.
Publishing and managing user-submitted content.
Responding to enquiries and feedback.
Reviewing and moderating submissions.
Improving website content, search indexing, and usability.
Understanding website readership and audience trends.
Detecting and preventing fraud, abuse, and security incidents.
Complying with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

sections.heading: User Reviews and Public Content
paragraphs: Research Factors may allow users to submit reviews, thoughts, comments, opinions, or other content.
If you submit content intended for public publication, some information associated with that submission may become publicly visible.
Before submitting content, consider whether you want to disclose personal information. Do not include sensitive personal information, passwords, financial account data, or confidential materials.

sections.heading: Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: Research Factors may use cookies and similar technologies to operate the website, remember preferences, understand website usage, improve performance, measure traffic, and support certain third-party services.
For complete details on our cookie classification, please review our Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: Analytics
paragraphs: We may use privacy-respecting analytics services to understand how visitors interact with Research Factors.
The information collected helps us understand which pages receive traffic, how visitors navigate the publication, general engagement patterns, website performance, and technical bottlenecks.
Analytics providers process information according to their own privacy policies and applicable legal terms.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services and Links
paragraphs: Research Factors may use third-party services to support website hosting, security, communications, and affiliate tracking.
Once you leave Research Factors and visit a third-party website, that website's own privacy policy and terms apply.
We are not responsible for the privacy practices of external websites that we do not control.

sections.heading: Sharing of Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information simply because you use Research Factors.
We may share information with service providers and trusted partners when reasonably necessary to operate our platform:
We may also disclose information when required by law, legal process, court order, governmental request, or to protect our rights, users, and safety.
bullets: Website hosting and infrastructure providers
Security, anti-spam, and CAPTCHA shields
Email and newsletter dispatch services
Database management and backup providers
Fraud prevention and technical audit services

sections.heading: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by applicable law.
Retention periods depend on the purpose of collection, legal and regulatory requirements, security safeguards, and operational needs.

sections.heading: Data Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information from unauthorized access, misuse, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
These include encrypted HTTPS transport, secure database storage, salted password hashing (Argon2/Bcrypt), and access-controlled administrative privileges.
However, no internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy

If you believe that a child has provided personal information to us without appropriate consent, please contact us so that we can take prompt corrective action.

sections.heading: Your Privacy Rights

bullets: Request access to personal information we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
Request deletion of your data where legally applicable.
Withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent.
Object to or request restriction of certain processing activities.
Receive an export of your information in a structured, machine-readable format.

sections.heading: International Data Processing
paragraphs: Depending on the services and cloud infrastructure used by Research Factors, personal information may be processed or stored in countries other than your home country.
Where required, we take appropriate contractual and technical steps in accordance with applicable law regarding international data transfers.

sections.heading: External Links

We do not control the privacy practices of external websites and recommend reviewing their privacy policies directly.

cookie-policy.title: Cookie Policy
intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Research Factors uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit or use our website.
By continuing to use our website, you acknowledge that cookies and similar technologies may be used as described in this policy, subject to applicable law and any consent choices available to you.

sections.heading: What Are Cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device when you visit them.
Cookies help websites remember preferences, maintain authentication sessions, understand traffic flows, improve performance, provide relevant features, and maintain cybersecurity.
Cookies may be temporary (session cookies) that expire when you close your browser, or persistent cookies that remain on your device until they expire or are deleted.

sections.heading: How Research Factors Uses Cookies
paragraphs: Research Factors uses cookies and similar technologies across several categories:

subSections.title: Essential Cookies
subSections.content: These cookies are strictly necessary for the website to function properly. They support security authentication, CSRF token validation, session persistence, and basic navigation. Because these cookies are essential, they cannot be switched off.

subSections.title: Preference Cookies
subSections.content: These cookies enable the website to remember your personalized settings (such as dark/light paper theme mode, text density, and reading width) to deliver a more convenient, consistent experience.

subSections.title: Analytics Cookies
subSections.content: Analytics technologies help us understand how visitors interact with Research Factors, which research categories are most popular, time spent on articles, and potential error pages. All data is aggregated and anonymized.

subSections.title: Advertising or Marketing Cookies
subSections.content: If Research Factors participates in affiliate programs or campaign measurements, these technologies use identifiers to track referrals or evaluate campaign effectiveness. They do not store personal details directly.

sections.heading: Third-Party Cookies
paragraphs: Some cookies may be placed by third-party services that appear on or support our website, such as analytics tools, cloud hosting infrastructure, or embedded diagrams.
Third-party providers process information according to their own privacy policies. We recommend reviewing the privacy notices of relevant third-party services for additional information.

sections.heading: Managing Cookies
paragraphs: You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject non-essential cookies. You can exercise your preferences by changing your browser settings.
Most modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) allow you to view stored cookies, delete existing cookies, block third-party cookies, or configure cookie warnings.
Please note that disabling certain essential cookies may affect the website's functionality or prevent you from accessing authenticated features.

sections.heading: Similar Technologies
paragraphs: In addition to cookies, Research Factors or third-party providers may use technologies such as web beacons, pixels, local storage (localStorage and sessionStorage), and session identifiers.
These technologies perform functions similar to cookies and help store your preferences and cached article drafts locally on your device.

sections.heading: Changes to This Cookie Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our website technologies, legal regulations, or privacy best practices.
The updated version will be published on this page with a revised 'Last Updated' date.

sections.heading: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions about our use of cookies or similar technologies, contact us:
Email: privacy@researchfactors.com
Website: https://researchfactors.com
Company: Research Factors Inc.

editorial-guidelines.title: Editorial Guidelines & Review Standards
editorial-guidelines.subtitle: Empirical Rigor, Independence, and Peer-Reviewed Fact-Checking
intro: Research Factors is dedicated to publishing evidence-first, peer-reviewed digital research, comparative studies, and in-depth product evaluations.
Our mission is to help readers understand complex choices by replacing speculative hype, promotional claims, and subjective bias with structured empirical inquiry.

These Editorial Guidelines govern every article, review, benchmark, and commentary published across Research Factors. Every author, contributing researcher, and editor is bound by these principles without exception.

sections.heading: Core Editorial Philosophy & Mission
paragraphs: At Research Factors, our guiding principle is 'Know More. Choose Better.' We believe that meaningful decisions—whether selecting enterprise software, investing in critical hardware, adopting cloud technologies, or understanding consumer services—require transparent, reproducible data.

We draw a strict boundary between verifiable empirical facts and editorial interpretation. Wherever subjective conclusions are drawn, the underlying data, methodologies, and reasoning must be explicitly laid bare for the reader to evaluate.
bullets: Empirical verification precedes any recommendation or synthesis.
Claims must be testable, reproducible, or anchored in reputable primary documentation.
We reject clickbait titles, sensationalized framing, and unsubstantiated superlatives.

sections.heading: Source Verification & Multi-Tier Fact-Checking
paragraphs: Factual accuracy is the cornerstone of our credibility. Every manuscript submitted to Research Factors undergoes rigorous pre-publication verification.

Our researchers prioritize primary sources over secondary reportage. When secondary sources must be cited, our editorial team audits the original research to verify that findings have not been distorted, taken out of context, or overstated.

subSections.title: Primary Sources Mandatory
subSections.content: Peer-reviewed academic papers, audited financial filings (SEC, ESMA), patented engineering specifications, official public documentation, and verified direct bench tests.

subSections.title: Double-Sourcing Rule
subSections.content: Any unverified, confidential, or disputed claims must be independently corroborated by at least two distinct, non-affiliated sources before inclusion.

bullets: Zero reliance on anonymous online message board rumors or unverified social media claims.
Mandatory inclusion of direct citations and hyperlinks to original whitepapers and source repositories.
Explicit attribution for all quotes, figures, benchmark datasets, and comparative metrics.

sections.heading: Product Evaluation, Benchmarking & Comparative Methodologies
paragraphs: When evaluating products, tools, and services, Research Factors implements standardized, repeatable testing protocols tailored to each respective domain.

Our comparative matrices are designed to evaluate real-world trade-offs rather than simplistic winner-takes-all conclusions. We recognize that an optimal solution for one enterprise or individual may be unsuitable for another.
bullets: Testing environments, hardware specifications, software versions, and runtime configurations are fully disclosed in every comparative study.
Products are evaluated across multiple balanced dimensions including performance, security, total cost of ownership, usability, data sovereignty, and vendor lock-in.
We strictly refuse vendor-provided review units that contain custom, non-production firmware or cherry-picked performance enhancements.
Where testing tools or benchmark suites are utilized, industry-standard and open-source tooling is preferred to ensure reproducibility.

sections.heading: Editorial Independence, Commercial Firewalls & Sponsorship
paragraphs: Research Factors maintains an impenetrable firewall between our editorial research staff and our commercial, sponsorship, and business operations.

Editorial coverage, manuscript evaluations, scoring, and publication schedules are determined solely by our editorial board. Commercial partners, sponsors, and advertisers have zero input into our research conclusions.

subSections.title: Zero Pre-Publication Review
subSections.content: No vendor, sponsor, advertiser, or agency is permitted to preview, edit, or influence any research article or comparative study prior to public release.

subSections.title: Unambiguous Sponsorship Disclosure
subSections.content: All sponsored research, brand partnerships, or underwriting arrangements carry prominent, indelible visual badges ('SPONSORED') and transparent partnership statements.

bullets: Editorial content is never created to satisfy commercial quotas or advertiser demands.
We do not accept paid inclusion in comparative guides or buyer rankings.
Affiliate relationships, if present, are secondary and never influence product evaluations or score determinations.

sections.heading: Byline Transparency & Author Accreditation
paragraphs: Accountability requires identity. Research Factors does not publish anonymous or uncredited staff articles on empirical subjects. Every article carries a verified byline with the author's real credentials, background, and research domain.
Authors must disclose any potential conflicts of interest, past consulting engagements, equity holdings, or advisory positions related to the companies or technologies covered.
bullets: Verified author profiles include academic background, industry experience, and linked professional citations.
Contributed articles from guest researchers undergo the exact same peer-review screening as in-house publications.
Ghostwriting and third-party corporate placement under staff bylines are strictly prohibited.

sections.heading: Corrections, Clarifications, and Retraction Policy
paragraphs: Despite rigorous verification, errors can occasionally occur. When an error of fact is identified, Research Factors is committed to correcting it swiftly, transparently, and completely.
We do not quietly overwrite or whitewash factual mistakes. Substantive corrections are acknowledged directly on the published manuscript with a clear timestamped errata notice.

subSections.title: Factual Corrections
subSections.content: Inaccuracies affecting data, names, figures, dates, or conclusions are appended with a prominent correction note detailing what was changed and why.

subSections.title: Retraction Protocol
subSections.content: In the rare event that a manuscript is found to contain fundamentally flawed methodology or plagiarized material, it is formally retracted with a public statement of cause.

bullets: Typographical or stylistic fixes that do not alter factual meaning are corrected directly without an errata flag.
Readers and subjects can submit formal correction requests directly to errata@researchfactors.com with supporting documentation.
All correction requests are reviewed within 48 business hours by an independent editor.

sections.heading: Artificial Intelligence & Algorithmic Assistance Directives
paragraphs: As an empirical research institution, Research Factors embraces modern computational tools while maintaining strict human accountability.
Generative artificial intelligence and machine-learning tools may be used as research assistants—for grammar review, syntax linting, or preliminary dataset formatting—but never as autonomous authors.
bullets: Every sentence, benchmark figure, and analytical conclusion must be written, verified, and endorsed by a human researcher.
Authors are legally and ethically accountable for all content published under their byline, regardless of tools used.
AI-generated synthetic citations, hallucinations, or unverified automated summaries will result in immediate disqualification of the manuscript and review of author accreditation.

sections.heading: Peer Discussion & Community Moderation Standards
paragraphs: Research Factors provides interactive peer discussion on research publications to foster academic discourse, critical scrutiny, and constructive inquiry.

We encourage readers and domain specialists to challenge our findings, present counter-benchmarks, and share empirical observations. However, all contributions must uphold high standards of civility and evidence.
bullets: Critiques must address the data and reasoning, not the person. Ad hominem attacks, harassment, and abusive conduct are not tolerated.
Commercial self-promotion, affiliate links, unsolicited marketing, and spam are strictly prohibited.
Comments containing hate speech, misinformation, or defamation are removed immediately by our moderation queue.
Readers can flag problematic contributions for editorial review via the community report triage system.
